name: TrustBridge Stellar Contract
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config libdbus-1-dev libudev-dev python3 jq && rustup target add wasm32v1-none wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install --locked stellar-cli@26.1.0
postAttachCommand: stellar --version && rustup target list --installed | grep wasm32v1-none && python3 --version
